info.title: Otherside Picnic
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata nel mondo moderno, ma esiste una porta che può trasportare le persone "dall'altra parte" dove strane leggende metropolitane prendono vita. Alla ricerca di soldi e di una persona importante, Sorawo e Toriko mettono piede nell'ignoto.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sorawo meets Toriko and adventures ensue amid conflicting emotions. Toriko figures out how they can make some money, but will the risks be worth the rewards?

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Sorawo meets Toriko and adventures ensue amid conflicting emotions. Toriko figures out how they can make some money, but will the risks be worth the rewards?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Sorawo and Toriko meet with an Otherside expert before heading back to the Otherside, where they come across a man looking for his wife. Toriko finds common cause with him because she, too, is seeking someone dear to her. But who is it that Sorawo seeks?

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: Sorawo and Toriko meet with an Otherside expert before heading back to the Otherside, where they come across a man looking for his wife. Toriko finds common cause with him because she, too, is seeking someone dear to her. But who is it that Sorawo seeks?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Sorawo can’t resist joining Toriko on the Otherside again. There, they set off to find a house Satsuki remembers visiting. As Sorawo gets to know Toriko and the Otherside better, she realizes how perilous relationships and adventures can be.

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: Sorawo can’t resist joining Toriko on the Otherside again. There, they set off to find a house Satsuki remembers visiting. As Sorawo gets to know Toriko and the Otherside better, she realizes how perilous relationships and adventures can be.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Sorawo and Toriko hit a rough patch, and Sorawo teams up with Kozakura. Kozakura explains why Toriko is the way she is, and Sorawo reveals new details about her own past. The Otherside will test friendships like never before.

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: Sorawo and Toriko hit a rough patch, and Sorawo teams up with Kozakura. Kozakura explains why Toriko is the way she is, and Sorawo reveals new details about her own past. The Otherside will test friendships like never before.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: An evening at Sorawo and Toriko’s favorite café takes a strange turn. On the Otherside, they have yet another unexpected encounter. Will this be the trip from which there is no return?

tmdb.title: Episodio 5

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Sorawo and Toriko meet Lieutenant Drake’s superior officer and learn more about what the soldiers have experienced on the Otherside. Back in our world, Kozakura continues to receive creepy calls. Will Sorawo and Toriko ever find their ticket home?

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: Sorawo and Toriko meet Lieutenant Drake’s superior officer and learn more about what the soldiers have experienced on the Otherside. Back in our world, Kozakura continues to receive creepy calls. Will Sorawo and Toriko ever find their ticket home?

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: A half-remembered night out, and the morning after. Beer, swimsuits, fun, sun, and guns. It’s just two girls on a resort vacation until a taxi ride takes a strange turn. Sorawo and Toriko will have to pull some magic out of a hat to escape this one.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: A request for help by a fellow university student leads to a hair-raising adventure. Will our heroines triumph once more, or are they headed for a complete cat-astrophe?

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Akari enlists Sorawo and Toriko to help a friend when the Otherside comes a knocking once more. Shocking new details about Satsuki emerge, and Toriko seems fixated on a certain aspect of Sorawo’s appearance.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis: Akari enlists Sorawo and Toriko to help a friend when the Otherside comes a knocking once more. Shocking new details about Satsuki emerge, and Toriko seems fixated on a certain aspect of Sorawo’s appearance.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: A planned celebration at a Japanese barbecue restaurant takes an unexpected detour. Akari gets lost, and Kozakura must face her fears. Once again, it’s up to Sorawo and Toriko to save the day.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
